item.title: Rev. J. M. Hsu (許錦銘)
item.description: Rev. J. M. Hsu (許錦銘) 許錦銘牧師 (Rev. J. M. Hsu, 1932 Changhua – 1995) was a 台神 graduate who took U.S. TPC / PCUS / RCA pulpits.

item.title: Good Shepherd Taiwanese Presbyterian Church
item.description: Good Shepherd Taiwanese Presbyterian Church Good Shepherd Taiwanese Presbyterian Church (好牧者臺灣基督長老教會, GSTPC) is a Taiwanese-language Presbyterian congregation in Monterey Park, Southern California.

item.title: Pastor Pingtung Lai (賴炳烔)
item.description: Pastor Pingtung Lai (賴炳烔) Pastor Pingtung Lai (賴炳烔, Lai Ping-tung) was a Taiwanese Presbyterian pastor, Bible Society pioneer, and evangelist.

item.title: Thomas Barclay (巴克禮)
item.description: Thomas Barclay (巴克禮) Thomas Barclay (巴克禮, POJ: Pa-khek-lé, 21 November 1849 – 5 October 1935) was a Scottish missionary of the Presbyterian Church of England.

item.title: Rev. Pinghsi Liu (劉炳熹)
item.description: Rev. Pinghsi Liu (劉炳熹) Rev. Pinghsi Liu (劉炳熹) is a PCT pastor. From 14 September 2020 he was 第十任 pastor of 台南東門巴克禮紀念教會.
